_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} a Tic Tac Toe. Manufarka ita ce cin nasara uku a jere (a kwance, a tsaye, ko a kwance) a kan allon. A lokacin da kake juyawa, ya kamata ka zaɓi lambar square (0-8) da kake son sanya alamar ka a gaba. Alal misali, '[4]' yana sanya alamar ka a cikin tantanin halitta na cibiyar. A matsayin Mai kunnawa {player_id}, za ku kasance '{symbol}', yayin da abokin adawar ku shine '{opponent_symbol}').

invalid_move.wrong_format: The submitted move does not follow the correct format.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ba shi da inganci. Dole ne ya kasance tsakanin 0 da 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Cell {cell} an riga an shagaltar da shi.

game_action.placed: Mai kunnawa {player_id} sanya alamar su ({symbol}) a cikin tantanin halitta {cell} .
